_comment: Templates in both app/src/main/assets/Kr and Jp that the existing template finds on both servers reference screenshots (2026-11-20). shown: the text the label shows on the other server; target_text: given where the APK localization does not hold it.
_comment_named: named: the specified-element run (cross_server.py --named). Per template, keyed by the server whose data, template and one screenshot (the same screenshot as the located run) the element was chosen from; the draft is for the other server. path: regex of the widget path; sprite: the sprite code sets on it (no widget names it in the data); shown: the text the label shows on that screenshot; target_text: the target text where the APK localization does not hold it; art: the element is not drawn from the APK (why); how: how it was chosen. Each choice rests on evidence from the source server only (recorded in how); the one agent that chose them had seen both servers' templates and screenshots during the work, so the choice is not blind.
